title: SERVICE OPERATIONS MANAGEMENT
description: Focuses on the management of global service operations including designing and managing systems to coordinate global information and material flows within and between firms in a supply chain. Covers planning operations, evaluating system alternatives, designing and researching global supply networks, examining complex adaptive systems and evaluating value stream synchronization.
registration_restrictions:
Prerequisites: BA 275 or 275H.
A minimum grade of C- is required in BA 275 and BA 275H.

Students with a term class standing of Freshman, Sophomore or Junior may not enroll.

Enrollment is limited to students with a program in Supply Chain & Logistic Manage (045) or Supply Chain & Logistics Mgmt (075).
